scientific.claim: Exact first-order frame correspondence for Box Excluded Middle, with a minimal two-point separation from the stronger published BEM condition.
scientific.integrity: The source's four-point counterexample is preserved as prior work; the new claim is the exact weaker condition and the independently proved two-point minimum witness.
limitations: The statement is specific to the standard birelational forcing semantics described in the cited source.
The finite enumeration through three points is auxiliary; the general theorem rests on the symbolic semantic proof.
A general correspondence framework might subsume the calculation abstractly, although no inspected source stated this exact equivalence.
scientific.object: Birelational intuitionistic modal frames and the Box Excluded Middle scheme.

title: Exact frame correspondence for Box Excluded Middle
